sentences.en: People fished from reed rafts using lines and nets and collected shellfish.

sentences.en: Specialities include hearty cassoulet, shellfish, and rotisserie chicken.

sentences.en: You might also want to avoid giving raw shellfish to your toddler to reduce their risk of getting food poisoning.

sentences.en: It keeps to the bottom - grubbing for insect larvae - worms and small shellfish.
